bio: Dasha Maximov is the founder of Whealth, a longevity and recovery clinic in the Dominican Republic, where she explores a simple but often overlooked question: what if one of the most powerful drivers of human health isn't another supplement or device, but the quality of our relationships—with ourselves, with others, and with life itself? After spending nearly a decade as a management consultant at PwC, Dasha left the corporate world to study neuroscience following her own long recovery from multiple concussions. That journey shifted her focus from treating symptoms to understanding the biological conditions that allow people to truly thrive. Today, she combines evidence-based longevity practices with systems thinking, helping practitioners and clinics integrate emerging therapies while creating environments that restore energy, resilience, and human connection.

Her work sits at the intersection of neuroscience, the nervous system, biohacking, and behavior change. She is particularly interested in how oxytocin influences the brain, gut, immune system, inflammation, and recovery—and why our modern pursuit of optimization may be overlooking one of the body's most powerful healing mechanisms.

In her talk, Dasha invites audiences to rethink longevity through a different lens: not simply extending lifespan, but increasing life force. She believes that when we cultivate genuine joy, safety, curiosity, and connection, physiology changes—and health becomes something we build from the inside out.Dasha's current work explores one of the most overlooked molecules in longevity: oxytocin. While often reduced to the "love hormone," emerging research suggests it plays a far broader role in brain health, gut function, immune regulation, metabolism, resilience, and healthy aging. Her work invites audiences to rethink joy and human connection as measurable biological interventions—not simply emotional experiences.

bio: Dave Korsunsky is a seasoned technology leader with over two decades of experience at the forefront of innovation, having held senior roles at some of the world’s most respected tech firms. As Director of Technical Alliances at VMware (NYSE: VMW), Dave led global partnerships with top-tier electronic health record (EHR) companies including EPIC, Cerner, McKesson, GE, and Allscripts—gaining a deep understanding of the complexities and limitations of legacy healthcare systems.

It was during this time that Dave began a personal journey to optimize his own health through data—wearables, lab results, continuous glucose monitors, and biometrics. But he quickly ran into a wall: there was no unified platform that allowed care providers to see the full picture of a patient’s health. The tools were fragmented, the data siloed, and the insights difficult to access and apply in clinical practice.

Dave recognized a critical opportunity: to build a platform that gives practitioners the ability to centralize and act on near real-time health data, empowering them to deliver more personalized, precise, and proactive care. That vision became Heads Up. As the Founder and CEO of Heads Up, Dave brings together his passion for health optimization and his deep technical expertise in enterprise-grade software, big data, and system integration. Before founding Heads Up, he led sales engineering at CloudPhysics, a cutting-edge data analytics firm processing over 80 billion data points per day—experience that now fuels the platform’s ability to integrate, analyze, and visualize clinical and lifestyle data at scale.

Today, Dave leads the company with the belief that when practitioners are equipped with the right tools and near real-time insights, they can transform outcomes and drive the future of precision health. He continues to drive the company forward as both a thought leader in digital health and a relentless advocate for root-cause, data-driven care.

This observation inspired a unique clinical model that combines interventional pain management, regenerative medicine, functional medicine, and longevity science.

At Vitality Medicine of New York, the focus extends beyond symptom management to identifying and addressing the root causes of disease and premature aging before chronic illness develops. Dr. Gopal believes longevity is driven largely by two critical factors: reducing cellular inflammation and optimizing mitochondrial health, the foundation of energy production, cellular repair, resilience, and healthy aging. Using advanced diagnostics, genomics, comprehensive biomarker analysis, metabolic and hormonal evaluation, gut health assessment, micronutrient testing, toxin screening, immune optimization, and lifestyle medicine, he develops highly personalized, data-driven health strategies tailored to each individual. Whether the goal is pain relief, increased energy, improved cognition, hormonal balance, metabolic health, enhanced performance, or disease prevention, Dr. Gopal's philosophy is simple: longevity is not an expensive biohack—it is the science of optimizing biological systems to help people live healthier, stronger, and more vibrant lives for decades to come.

bio: Jonathan Ramalho is the founder of The Longevity Network, a membership built for longevity founders to operate at their full potential, paired with genuine partnerships and real business growth. He is also the director of one of the most urgently needed documentaries in the longevity space. That film, Beyond The Pill, currently on its global premiere tour, brings together an unprecedented cast of visionaries: alongside Jonathan, it features Wim Hof, Prof. Tim Spector MBE and Jonathan Wolf (ZOE), Marisa Peer, Davinia Taylor, Dr. Matt Dawson, Dr. Mohammed Enayat, Dr. Simon Ruffell, his coach Anne Espiritu, and UFC fighter Michael Page.

Over more than 15 years building campaigns for NGOs, CBS News, The Economist, Reuters, and global longevity companies, Jonathan has built his career on the power of narrative. Yet the most consequential story he has ever uncovered is his own: a first-hand journey from a London psychiatric ward to the world's leading longevity stages. While on a mission to document the future of work, he fell down the rabbit hole in search of solutions to what the WHO calls the trillion-dollar problem of anxiety and depression. That search led him to psychedelics, and to an ayahuasca retreat in South America that triggered a psychosis, hospitalisation on a London psychiatric ward, and a diagnosis of schizophrenia. He describes the experience as discovering the darkest corner of his mind and being unable to close the door on his way out. So he did something different. He applied his strategic discipline to his own biology. Bridging ancient practice with cutting-edge neuroscience, biohacking, and psychosynthesis, Ramalho reverse-engineered a complete recovery: freeing himself from medication and unlocking a new baseline of health, performance, and prevention. Beyond The Pill maps the framework that emerged from that journey—four pillars (Food, Mood, Move, Sleep) and a three-stage model designed to replace the Sick Care paradigm: Recovery → Performance → Prevention.

The microbiome is often described as the biggest untapped opportunity in healthcare and though its connection to a wide range of health outcomes is well established, it remains outside of routine healthcare. Paul co-founded Intus Bio to change that by combining unique next-generation sequencing technology and AI to make the microbiome as central to healthcare, as it is to our health

Paul and Intus Bio share a bold but simple mission: test everybody, every year, for every disease. Through the harnessing of the microbiome’s significant influence on health and the power of Intus Bio’s technology, earlier detection and prevention of many diseases will be possible.

bio: Sam Tejada is an entrepreneur, wellness innovator, media personality, and nationally recognized voice helping shape the future of longevity and health optimization. Under Sam's leadership, Liquivida has evolved from one of the nation's early pioneers in IV therapy into a state-of-the-art longevity and wellness destination. Today, Sam is passionate about making cutting-edge longevity technologies more accessible, helping bridge the gap between emerging science and practical, everyday health optimization with advanced longevity diagnostics, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, red light therapy, regenerative medicine, brain optimization technologies, metabolic health, and other evidence-informed approaches designed to help people optimize how they look, feel, and perform throughout life.

Sam serves on the Leadership Advisory Board of the American IV Association and is the host of the Vitamin Infusion Business Expo (VIBE), one of the wellness industry's premier conferences dedicated to innovation, education, and collaboration. He is also an active participant in the broader national conversation around health and wellness, regularly attending MAHA meetings, events, and discussions focused on improving health in America.

Through his work across the wellness and longevity industry, Sam has become known for connecting many of the leading voices in longevity, functional medicine, and wellness to share knowledge, challenge conventional thinking, and accelerate innovation. He believes the future of healthcare will be driven by collaboration, education, and greater access to evidence-informed longevity solutions. That philosophy was the basis for his book, How to Win in Modern Wellness, a collaborative project that brings together many of the industry's leading innovators to share ideas, elevate standards, and advance the future of healthcare. Sam’s podcast, A Healthy Point of View, is further proof of his commitment to education and collaboration, as he interviews leading physicians, scientists, researchers, entrepreneurs, athletes, and thought leaders who are helping shape the future of longevity, human performance, and personalized healthcare. His insights have been featured by Forbes and numerous national media outlets, and he has appeared on programs including Good Morning America (GMA), KTLA News, and a variety of television shows, podcasts, and industry publications.
